entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for an item I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I start with your name and order number?
Sure. It's Mark Peterson, order number VF78910.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the ProFit Jersey. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. I ordered the medium, but it's the wrong size for me. The jersey is just too tight across the chest.
I see. Getting the right fit is important. Were you hoping to do an exchange for a different size, or a full return?
I'd like to do a return. I'm not sure if the large will fit right either, so I'd rather not do an exchange right now.

Completely understandable. Let me just confirm the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 58 days ago. Since this is a standard apparel item, it falls under our 10-day return policy. You are unfortunately outside that window, so I am happy to approve this return for a full refund.

That's great news, thank you for making that simple. I do have one question. Since I have to package this up and make a trip to the post office, would it be possible to get a small store credit or a discount code for my next purchase, just for the hassle?

I understand your request, Mark. While our policy doesn't allow for credits on a standard size-related return, I can confirm that the return shipping is completely free. I've just emailed a pre-paid shipping label to the address on file. All you need to do is print it and attach it to the package.
Okay, a pre-paid label is fair enough. I appreciate you checking on that for me. That's all I needed.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks again, David.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
